senses.gloss: m. pl. (גלי; cmp. שִׁילְהֵי fr. שלה) [uncoverings,] flashes, the glowing horizon.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 3b:11">Taan. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>גי׳ דליליא</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="C00674"><he>גו׳</he></cite>) the glow after sunset.

<cite ref="Pesachim 13a">Pes. 13ᵃ</cite> top <he>בגי׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בגילויא</he>) he was standing in the glow before sunrise (mistaking it for the flashing of sunrise, v. <cite ref="E00692"><he>הָנֵץ</he></cite>); <cite ref="Sanhedrin 42a">Snh. 42ᵃ</cite> (ed. <he>בגילויא</he>).
